must_find.description: Primary endpoint wording drifts across overall response rate, objective response rate, and overall remission rate while reusing ORR and the same 50% figure.
must_find.locus_hint: Methods vs Results vs Discussion endpoint phrases

must_not.description: Must not invent a numeric conflict: all stated rates are 50%.
Do not require Critical solely for terminology drift when the numeric value is identical; Minor/Major/Needs Review are acceptable.

agent_expectations.scoring_notes: Acceptable if Agent flags terminology inconsistency with loci. Severity is not unique—band Minor–Major–Needs Review. Fail only if drift is missed entirely or Critical is asserted without rationale.
